items.title: FSLR Q3 deep dive: bookings slowdown and pricing strength amid policy uncertainty
items.summary: Solar panel manufacturer First Solar (NASDAQ:FSLR) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with sales falling 22.8% year on year to $1.23 billion. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $4.75 billion at the midpoint came in 5.7% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $5.30 per share was 13.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
